exact_obstruction: For the specified traceless four-observable C5 frame, no real scalar alpha and no exact optimal pure-state envelope G can make alpha(L+G)_A^T+(1-alpha)((L+G)_B+(L+G)_C)/2-W PSD. Exact necessary bounds are alpha>=67/121 and alpha<=11/21.
exact_corrected_theorem: If an m-dimensional traceless Hermitian frame has a PSD local C2 certificate Xs,Ys with exact trace Vs+ks, extend its observables by zero and add a traceless central D=cI_S direct-sum D_T. If min_spec(D_T)|d-c|^2/2 >= ||sum Bi^T tensor Bi||, then the exact envelope is Gs direct-sum 0 + D^2 and X=Xs direct-sum 0 + D^2, Y=Ys direct-sum 0 + D^2/2 is a C2 certificate for every globally tracial three-party state.
importance: Blocks a direct generalization of the new spin-one scalar allocation while preserving the desired target inequality on the same exact test. Establishes that general envelope information may need observables or block components allocated separately.

strongest_supplied_prior_result.scope: All-weight vector spin-one operator certificate with allocation 3/5,1/5,1/5, expressly supplied by the parent as independently reconstructed.

new_mechanism: Combine a perturbed spin equality-space constraint with a classical close-eigenvalue constraint; then repair the scalar obstruction using a central variance sum of squares that pays for mixed block sectors.
load_bearing_missing_lemma_for_ambitious: A local-dual construction within the V+k budget for arbitrary frames, with no central block or PSD base-certificate assumption. The gluing lemma does not supply that construction.
compatibility_obligations: The obstruction tests the operator certificate, not a tracial legal-state violation.
All C5 observables are traceless and the envelope is exactly optimal.
The gluing lemma assumes PSD base local operators and an explicit spectral separation gap.
All three global marginals must be I/d for the resulting expectation bound.
The test is reducible; no global minimality among arbitrary frames is claimed.
early_falsification_test: Exact rational expectations on the spin equality vector and |4,5,5>; all 27 corrected-dual blocks independently checked by exact LDL elimination.
likely_significance_if_extended: A mechanism for more general local duals might advance the universal broadcast gate; this result alone is scoped to central block extensions.
